capRemoved.decision: Lift the URL cap. The site is scaling SEO pages up deliberately, and every release had come to mean editing maxUrls first -- the guard had become paperwork rather than a decision.
capRemoved.whatRemains: check-url-budget.mjs no longer fails the build on a number. It still prints the URL count and the delta against the last recorded build every run, so the growth rate stays visible in the verify output instead of disappearing.

routeStandards: Every new route must be backed by written GA4/GSC evidence, reliable sources, a distinct human search intent, substantive copy, and sitemap reconciliation. Future writing batches are capped at 5 pages; related batches should accumulate into a coherent 30-60 page cluster before one deployment. Packages 047-052 add cleaning, boiling, brewing, drying, and steaming intents; packages 053-058 add cooking-cycle and prep-session intents for small kitchen appliances; packages 059-064 extend the cluster to pressure cooking, griddling, mixing, and espresso routines; packages 065-070 extend the same measured unit-cost method to baking, dehydration, incubation, reheating, and short motor-use routines; packages 071-076 extend it to ice making, juicing, grinding, extrusion, frothing, and hourly food holding; packages 077-082 extend the cluster to printing, scanning, 3D printing, gaming, soundbar viewing, and desktop-speaker listening units; packages 083-088 extend it to labeling, shredding, laminating, 3D scanning, standing-desk adjustment, and smart-speaker listening units, backed by EIA electricity-price and household-use context, ENERGY STAR computer/imaging-equipment guidance, and CFPB spending context.

history.note: Kept as the record of a real incident. Do not delete: this is why the counter exists at all.
history.2026-07-25: Site-level ranking collapse. The sitemap went 41 -> 341 URLs between 2026-07-19 and 2026-07-23 (five-language site shell + a 100-page growth pack) on a YMYL money domain with no authority. GSC impressions fell from 87/day to 3/day and stayed there. Nothing in the pipeline noticed the URL count moving, which is why the cap was introduced.
history.2026-09-02: Cap lifted. It stood at 940 with the sitemap at 937, having been raised repeatedly through SEO clusters 023-064.
